Nico Alvarez: Running a quickpack for Orbit after merging LoRA v3 into base-saturn. Seeing invoice amounts lose commas in outputs. posting quick numbers.
Priya Desai: paste the quickpack summary pls.
Nico Alvarez: ```
pack: 300 invoice-like prompts (customer subset)
model: base-saturn + lora_orbit_v3
quant-sim: fp16 -> int8 and int4
metrics (base -> merged):
- amount_exact: 0.895 -> 0.842 (-5.3%)
- overall_f1: 0.88 -> 0.86 (-2.3%)
- avg_tok_ll: -1.87 -> -2.10
- p95 latency (sim): 120ms -> 98ms
issues: amounts like '2,300.00' -> '2300.00' or '2300' (commas dropped)
```
Kai Morgan: Did you use the tokenizer preserve flag? numeric tokens sometimes merge differently under int4.
Nico Alvarez: Ran default sim: `python infra/quant_sim.py --model base-saturn --lora loras/orbit_v3.pt --bits 4`. No preserve flags.
Priya Desai: Can we try two things: 1) blends with alpha 0.5/0.6; 2) few-shot examples enforcing comma formatting in system prompt. Also add a slot-extract harness specifically for amount tokens.
Kai Morgan: I'll set up an int8 sim and run alpha=0.6 tonight. Also suggest a lightweight postprocess that reinserts separators using locale-aware formatting before downstream consumption.
eval-bot: Automated alert: amount_exact regression > threshold. Stored: s3://redwood-evals/orbit/saturn-lora/1767000000/results.json
Nico Alvarez: Plan: run alpha=0.6 int8 sim + slotpack (500 prompts), try few-shot system message "Always format amounts with commas for en_US" and test postprocess normalizer. If still regress, pin routing to saturn-stable for Orbit during canary.
Priya Desai: Customer priority: amount exactness > small latency wins. Keep them on saturn-stable fallback if unsure.
Nico Alvarez: Update: alpha=0.6 + int8 sim improved amount_exact to -1.2% and postprocess recovers ~92% of comma cases. Will merge with alpha=0.6 + output normalizer and 24h canary.
Kai Morgan: I'll create a small feature-flag to route Orbit traffic to saturn-stable for canary window and monitor eval dashboards.
Nico Alvarez: Final: merge with alpha=0.6, enable normalizer, 24h canary, customer notified.
